title: Transfer of graph integrals to the parameter ball
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, W ⊆ U open, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, r > 0 with B_r(ξ) ⊆ W (closed ball), a ≥ 0, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, P : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝⁿ continuous linear with P(ιv) = v and P(ι'w) = 0 for all v, w, and f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| and |f(v)| ≤ r/4 for all v, w. Put Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v), F := Φ(ℝⁿ) (Lean range), D := B̆ⁿ_{r/2}(0) (open ball of ℝⁿ), fʲ := EuclideanSpace.proj j ∘ f. Assume θ(x) = R.mult x = 1 for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_r(ξ), Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0, and Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_r(ξ)) ≤ a. Then: (a) for every measurable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ and G ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ g ≤ G: (∫_D g dLⁿ) ≤ (∫_{Φ(D)} g(P(x − ξ)) dμ(x)) + G·a, as lower integrals of ENNReal.ofReal (the last term is ENNReal.ofReal(G·a), added outside the second integral); (b) for every measurable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ and G ∈ ℝ with |g| ≤ G: |(∫_D g dLⁿ) − (∫_{Φ(D)} g(P(x − ξ)) dμ(x))| ≤ G·(a + 2ⁿ·(∫_D Σ_{j∈Fin k} ‖Dfʲ(v)‖² dLⁿ(v))), i.e. the absolute value of the difference of the two separately computed Bochner integrals (the subtraction lies outside both integrals), with Dfʲ = fderiv ℝ fʲ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r a : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → 0 ≤ a → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall ξ r → R.mult x = 1) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → μHE[n] ((range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) \ R.measure.support) ∩ closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → (∀ (g : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, 0 ≤ g v) → (∀ v, g v ≤ G) → (∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (g v)) ≤ (∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (g (P (x - ξ))) ∂R.measure) + ENNReal.ofReal (G * a)) ∧ ∀ (g : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, |g v| ≤ G) → |(∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), g v) - (∫ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), g (P (x - ξ)) ∂R.measure)| ≤ G * (a + 2 ^ n * (∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ∑ j : Fin k, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun v => EuclideanSpace.proj j (f v)) v‖ ^ 2))
